actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Create a complete freshly drawn full-body Bunny pose illustration on WIDE white paper with generous margins for both full blades and both feet. Scale the WHOLE scene uniformly to fit; never shorten limbs or knives to fit an old canvas.

REFERENCE AUTHORITY:
Image 1: the exact two assembled fictional daggers, colors and blade/hilt proportions.
Image 2: the verified RIGHT-hand NORMAL grip connection only. This original-pixel close-up is not pasted into the image; redraw its hand structure naturally at the new pose scale.
Image 3: Bunny's successful grounded low stance, right leg bent forward/left leg planted behind, shoulder/hip turn, face, clothing, left hand and downward ivory knife. Its RIGHT grip and dark knife orientation are WRONG and must NOT be inherited.

REPLACE the right fist and rotate the whole dark dagger to match the actual connection in image 2. The black-gloved THUMB and INDEX FINGER are together immediately beside the GUARD end of the handle, on the fist's outward/left side. The other fingers follow around the grip, with LITTLE FINGER at the opposite end; ONE dark angular pommel emerges from that little-finger side, toward the fist's right/rear. Show the thumb opposing the curled index/fingers and the hand truly enclosing the ONE grip. Guard stays outside the fist next to thumb/index, NOT beside little finger. Use the clear three-quarter palm anatomy of image 2 rather than retaining the old hand from image 3.

Consequently the DARK BLADE must project from the fist to the LEFT/OUTSIDE of the figure, with enough blank space to show its entire pointed end. Let the blade angle naturally outward and slightly down/up as the correct wrist requires; DO NOT preserve image 3's blade pointing inward/right across the forward leg. The arm stays forward low; correct normal grip is more important than the old knife direction.

Keep the LEFT high rear hand exactly as the successful reverse grip in image 3: exposed finger ends and thumb, orange-rimmed fingerless glove, orange wrist screen; single ivory pommel above thumb/index, one actual grip in fist, red collar/curved guard below little finger, ivory blade descending outside/down. No extra hilt or branching grip.

Keep the canonical dark broad angular fang/shoulder/waist/silver edge/red root wedge, hard guard/faceted grip/dark orange pommel; ivory swept outer curve/inner shoulder/red root wedge/curved guard/contoured grip/ivory teardrop orange pommel from image 1. Nominal dark .36H0 and ivory .42H0 unchanged, perspective not an excuse to redesign. Only one red collar beside each guard; no extra red ring at pommel.

Keep image 3's full character identity, goggles-only silver hair and blue eyes, focused closed mouth, original outfit, left-sleeve-only OG, pure black pants belt and empty rear mounts, right red cuff/full black fingers, right thigh modules/white short sock, left orange long stocking and original boots. Do not change body or feet proportions. Clean Japanese hand-drawn lines and hard cel colors, no added white spots, cloudy texture or plastic highlights. One complete figure, no panels or captions.
